scores.-2: Talar head palpable on lateral side only (marked supination)
scores.-1: Talar head palpable on lateral side, slightly on medial side
scores.0: Talar head equally palpable on both sides (neutral)
scores.+1: Talar head palpable on medial side, slightly on lateral side
scores.+2: Talar head palpable on medial side only (marked pronation)

scores.-2: Curve below lateral malleolus is straight or convex (marked supination)
scores.-1: Curve below lateral malleolus is slightly concaved
scores.0: Curves above and below lateral malleolus are approximately equal (neutral)
scores.+1: Curve below lateral malleolus is noticeably more concave than above
scores.+2: Curve below lateral malleolus is acutely concave (marked pronation)

talonavicular_bulging.name: Bulging in Region of Talonavicular Joint

scores.-2: Talonavicular joint area markedly concave (marked supination)
scores.+2: Area is markedly bulging / prominent convex bulge (marked pronation)

medial_longitudinal_arch.name: Height and Congruence of Medial Longitudinal Arch

scores.-2: Arch high and acutely angled (cavus foot)
scores.0: Arch height normal with smooth concentric curve

forefoot_abduction_adduction.name: Abduction / Adduction of Forefoot on Rearfoot

scores.-2: Medial toes clearly more visible than lateral toes
scores.-1: Medial toes slightly more visible than lateral toes
scores.0: Medial and lateral toes equally visible
scores.+1: Lateral toes slightly more visible than medial toes
scores.+2: Lateral toes clearly more visible than medial toes

assessment_policy.full_score_requires: All six clinician-entered items for the same foot and examination, including tactile palpation
assessment_policy.photo_metrics: Unvalidated 2D descriptors only; never converted automatically to FPI item scores
assessment_policy.fascial_inference: Disabled: a total FPI score alone does not establish tissue mechanics or upstream movement
